description: Query what abap2UI5 can express, from the verified capability map (CAPABILITIES.md — every entry names a proving port). Call this BEFORE deciding a UI5 feature cannot be built. Without arguments returns a summary; with `query` and/or `status` returns matching entries (status: direct | workaround | needs-live-test | not-expressible) - paged: an answer stops at about 60,000 characters, and `more` names the `offset` to continue at.

limit.description: maximum entries to return (default: every match that fits about 60,000 characters)

offset.description: skip this many matches - the paging cursor a `more` hint names (default 0)

query.description: keywords matched against feature/how/evidence, e.g. "tree binding" or "dialog"

status.description: optional filter on the capability status

name: capabilities
